topics.title: Custodes Statline Overhaul & Unit Removals - What Changed?
topics.what_is_driving_it: New Custodes codex rules reveal significant statline changes and removal of previously available units, sparking competitive analysis.
topics.relevance_note: High-velocity discussion around a major faction update with direct impact on army building and tournament viability. Multiple channels covering it simultaneously.
topics.gap_note: Strong demand for detailed breakdowns of what changed, why it matters for competitiveness, and how to adapt lists. Visual comparison videos and 'winners/losers' analysis are underrepresented.

topics.title: The Lion Returns - Dark Angels Divergent Chapter Rules Deep Dive
topics.what_is_driving_it: Lion El'Jonson's return with new rules prompts community excitement; Divergent Chapter mechanics create faction customization questions.
topics.relevance_note: High engagement around a primarch return (major lore moment) combined with accessible competitive rules interest. Multiple creators covering it.
topics.gap_note: Content opportunity: cinematic lore explainer on why Lion's return matters to 40K narrative + tactical guide on how Divergent Chapters actually work in practice.

topics.title: Kill Team Legion of the Damned - Faction Breakdown & Army Building
topics.what_is_driving_it: New Legion of the Damned Kill Team roster added to Armageddon; community interest in understanding how this faction fits the meta.
topics.relevance_note: Kill Team has momentum with Armageddon launch; Legion of the Damned is thematically powerful and tactically fresh. Multiple tournament/gameplay videos emerging.
topics.gap_note: Opportunity to own 'complete Legion of the Damned guide' — aesthetics, lore, army building tips, and how they stack up vs other Kill Team factions. Visual showcase + tactical content.

topics.title: Space Marine 2 Patch 15 - Complete Changelog & Meta Impact
topics.what_is_driving_it: Latest patch brings major balance changes to Space Marine 2; players seeking comprehensive breakdown of what shifted.
topics.relevance_note: Video game audience overlap with tabletop community; patch changes affect competitive play and casual experience. High search interest.
topics.gap_note: Detailed visual explainer of patch notes — before/after comparisons, which builds got nerfed/buffed, strategic implications. Format: patch notes + gameplay clips showing changes.

topics.title: Warhammer Tone Pro Paints - Professional Painting Technique Tutorials
topics.what_is_driving_it: Official 'Eavy Metal showcase series on new Warhammer Tone Pro paint range; Golden Demon winner Angelo Di Chello featured.
topics.relevance_note: New product line from GW with official backing and expert endorsement. Hobby audience actively seeking paint recommendations and technique content.
topics.gap_note: Content gap: step-by-step video tutorials on using Tone Pro for specific colors (yellows, reds, oranges per official content); link to award-winning techniques. Beginner-friendly 'how to paint like a Slayer Sword winner' angle.

topics.title: Warhammer 40K Year 3 Roadmap & Space Marine 3 Announcement
topics.what_is_driving_it: Official Year 3 content roadmap released; Space Marine 3 confirmed as 'MASSIVE' release with community speculating implications.
topics.relevance_note: Major franchise announcement with high anticipation. Creators actively discussing what's coming and why it matters. Strong momentum leading into 2026-2027.

topics.title: Incubi Lore Explained - Dark Eldar Melee Specialists Deep Dive
topics.what_is_driving_it: Majorkill produces lore explainer on Incubi; niche faction receiving community attention.
topics.relevance_note: Recurring demand for accessible lore content on underexplored factions. Majorkill's 'By An Australian' format has established audience.
topics.gap_note: Content format opportunity: short, punchy lore explainers on niche factions (Incubi, Harlequins, etc.) that combine narrative, visual references, and why they're cool. Fill the gap between Majorkill and cinematic deep-dives.

topics.title: Kill Team Tournament Experiences - Beginner Guide & Faction Breakdown
topics.what_is_driving_it: Multiple creators sharing tournament reports and beginner Kill Team guides; community asking 'how do I get started?' and 'what faction should I play?'
topics.relevance_note: Kill Team Armageddon launch creates entry point for new players. Tournament content and beginner guides show strong engagement.
topics.gap_note: Recurring question: 'How do I start Kill Team competitively?' Opportunity: beginner's tournament guide + faction tier list + 'I entered a tournament with no experience' series format.

topics.title: Superglue as a Hobby Technique - Unconventional Miniature Painting Methods
topics.what_is_driving_it: Resourceful Miniatures demonstrates superglue use in painting workflow; community curious about non-traditional techniques.
topics.relevance_note: Niche but high-engagement hobby craft content. Viewers seeking budget tips and alternative methods.
topics.gap_note: Content gap: 'unconventional painting hacks' series exploring non-obvious tools and techniques. Superglue application, tape tricks, household items for effects. DIY/budget-friendly angle appeals to growing audience.
